note: ECHOLIVITY SDD-3000 factory programs. Fields are those the original stored per program (delay time + REGENERATION + MODULATION + EFFECT), plus three ECHOLIVITY extensions (time_mode, sync, division). Frequency/Intensity/Feedback/Balance use the hardware 0-10 scales. 'source' marks settings taken from the 1982 owner's manual application chart (OM).

programs.name: Classic Echo
programs.source: OM 'natural echo' advice (highs decay faster than lows)

programs.name: Short Slap
programs.source: OM slapback: 123 ms, FB 3, LOW 125 Hz, INT 0, LB 3

programs.name: Metallic Flange
programs.source: OM flanging: 3-5 ms, FB 5, INV on, LOW 125 Hz, TRI, INT 6, FREQ 3, LB 5

programs.name: Wide Doubling
programs.source: OM doubling: 33 ms, FB 4, INV on, HIGH 4 kHz, TRI, INT 3, FREQ 2, LB 4 (use OUT MODE: STEREO A)

programs.name: Vibrato
programs.source: ECHOLIVITY: effect-only short delay, triangle ~4.5 Hz

programs.name: Random Drift
programs.source: ECHOLIVITY: smoothed RND at ~0.7 Hz, low intensity (OM: keep RND intensity low)

programs.name: Infinite Hold
programs.source: OM HOLD: full 1023 ms, flat filters. Press HOLD to freeze (HOLD is not stored, as on the original)

programs.name: Rhythmic Modulation
programs.source: OM 'echo with pitch shift' (SQUARE, low INT), synced dotted 1/8
